state:

Stage 8 on disk: the `php-migration/` topic is dissolved, `divergesFromPhp` and `docs/divergences.md` are gone, every `php`-tagged fence under `docs/rules/` is `nvs`, and the testing rules no longer name the oracle. The incidental-mention sweep is done in `classes`, `core-api`, `types`, `core-classes`, `ide`, `tooling`, `packaging`, `statements`, `expressions`, `config`, `enums`, `errors` and `iteration`. Two PHP-to-Novis tables went with it: `config/ini-set-is-core-config-set` now lists the four `Core\Config` methods (its title changed, its id stays), and `enums/no-class-machinery` lists jobs, not PHP spellings.

The Stage 9 checks the driver reports red are not written yet; they follow Stage 8.
